IS 6488 : 2024 Textiles - Cotton Webbing for Personal Web Equipment - Specification
ICS 59.060.10
ICS 59.060.10
TXD 39
TXD 39
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the constructional particulars and other requirements of various types of cotton webbing. The standard covers webbing used in the manufacture of personal web equipment, carrier manpack, waterproof capes, snow shoes, map cases, holdalls, ammunition carriers, and stretcher bags, etc.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
